effects: The signer sends `amount` wstUSR (collateral 0x1202F5C7…, set at initialization) to the vault with safeTransferFrom.
The vault credits active stake shares to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily the signer. The share count comes from the vault's storage.
formats.shown: Deposit of the amount in wstUSR into the named vault, credited to the shown beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many vault shares the beneficiary receives; the count comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor has no shares field, and shares are not in the calldata.

effects: The vault burns the signer's active shares worth `amount` wstUSR, rounded up (previewWithdraw, Ceil).
The vault moves `amount` wstUSR out of the active stake into the withdrawal queue for the next epoch.
`claimer` receives withdrawal shares for that epoch, which is the right to claim the assets later. No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: A request to withdraw the amount in wstUSR from the vault, with the claim owned by the shown claimer.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the shares burned, or that funds are claimable only after the next epoch.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` and _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares;`. Both values come from storage.

effects: The vault burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
The vault queues the wstUSR worth those shares (previewRedeem from storage) for withdrawal in the next epoch.
`claimer` receives withdrawal shares for that epoch, which is the right to claim the assets later.
formats.shown: A request to queue a raw integer of vault shares for withdrawal, owned by the shown claimer.

findings.title: redeem shows the vault share amount as a raw 18-decimal integer, which is hard to read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` has format "raw". Case 2 shows "987654321123456789". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset returns 0, so shares use the 18-decimal scale of wstUSR.
findings.fix: Use format "unit" with params {"base":"shares","decimals":18} for `#.shares`. Keep it in interpolatedIntent as "Queue {shares} for {claimer}".

findings.title: redeem does not show the wstUSR amount that gets queued; the vault computes it from storage.

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
The vault sends the signer's full withdrawal amount for that epoch, in wstUSR, to `recipient`. The amount comes from storage.
formats.shown: A claim of the withdrawal for the shown epoch, sent to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claim does not show the wstUSR amount sent to the recipient; it comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `amount = _claim(epoch); IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` with `_claim` returning `withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)`.

findings.title: The claim intent does not name the asset wstUSR that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor claim intent "Claim withdrawal", interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}". Vault.sol claim transfers `collateral` (wstUSR).
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Claim epoch {epoch} wstUSR to {recipient}".

effects: The vault marks the signer's withdrawal as claimed for every listed epoch.
The vault sends the sum of the signer's withdrawal amounts for those epochs, in wstUSR, to `recipient`. The amounts come from storage.
formats.shown: A claim of the withdrawals for each listed epoch, sent to the shown recipient.

findings.title: claimBatch does not show the total wstUSR sent to the recipient; it comes from storage.
The claimBatch intent does not name the asset wstUSR that goes to the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor claimBatch intent "Claim withdrawals", interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Claim wstUSR for epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

redeem(address claimer,uint256 shares).worst: redeem shows the vault share amount as a raw 18-decimal integer, which is hard to read.

summary.worst: redeem shows the vault share amount as a raw 18-decimal integer, which is hard to read.
